description: DataplexMetadataFeed is the Schema for the DataplexMetadataFeed API

apiVersion.description: APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object. Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and may reject unrecognized values. More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description: Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents. Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to. Cannot be updated. In CamelCase. More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: DataplexMetadataFeedSpec defines the desired state of DataplexMetadataFeed

filters.description: Optional. The filters of the metadata feed. Only the changes that match the filters are published.

aspectTypeRefs.description: Optional. The aspect types that you want to listen to.

items.description: AspectTypeRef is a reference to a DataplexAspectType.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed DataplexAspectType resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/locations/{{location}}/aspectTypes/{{aspecttypeID}}".

name.description: The name of a DataplexAspectType resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a DataplexAspectType resource.

changeTypes.description: Optional. The type of change that you want to listen to. If not specified, all changes are published.

entryTypeRefs.description: Optional. The entry types that you want to listen to.

items.description: EntryTypeRef is a reference to a DataplexEntryType.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed DataplexEntryType resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/locations/{{location}}/entryTypes/{{entrytypeID}}".

name.description: The name of a DataplexEntryType resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a DataplexEntryType resource.

projectRef.description: The project that this resource belongs to.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

kind.description: The kind of the Project resource; optional but must be `Project` if provided.

pubsubTopicRef.description: Optional. The pubsub topic that you want the metadata feed messages to publish to. Please grant Dataplex service account the permission to publish messages to the topic.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed PubSubTopic resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/topics/{{topicID}}".

name.description: The name of a PubSubTopic resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a PubSubTopic resource.

resourceID.description: The DataplexMetadataFeed name. If not given, the metadata.name will be used.

scope.description: Required. The scope of the metadata feed. Only the in scope changes are published.

entryGroupRefs.description: Optional. The entry groups whose entries you want to listen to.

items.description: EntryGroupRef is a reference to a DataplexEntryGroup.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed DataplexEntryGroup resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/locations/{{location}}/entryGroups/{{entrygroupID}}".

name.description: The name of a DataplexEntryGroup resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a DataplexEntryGroup resource.

organizationLevel.description:
Optional. Whether the metadata feed is at the organization-level.

 - If `true`, all changes happened to the entries in the same
 organization as the feed are published.
 - If `false`, you must specify a list of projects or a list of entry
 groups whose entries you want to listen to.

 The default is `false`.

projectRefs.description: Optional. The projects whose entries you want to listen to.

items.description: The Project that this resource belongs to.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

kind.description: The kind of the Project resource; optional but must be `Project` if provided.

status.description: DataplexMetadataFeedStatus defines the config connector machine state of DataplexMetadataFeed

conditions.description: Conditions represent the latest available observations of the object's current state.

lastTransitionTime.description: Last time the condition transitioned from one status to another.

message.description: Human-readable message indicating details about last transition.

reason.description: Unique, one-word, CamelCase reason for the condition's last transition.

status.description: Status is the status of the condition. Can be True, False, Unknown.

type.description: Type is the type of the condition.

externalRef.description: A unique specifier for the DataplexMetadataFeed resource in GCP.

observedGeneration.description: ObservedGeneration is the generation of the resource that was most recently observed by the Config Connector controller. If this is equal to metadata.generation, then that means that the current reported status reflects the most recent desired state of the resource.

observedState.description: ObservedState is the state of the resource as most recently observed in GCP.

createTime.description: Output only. The time when the feed was created.

uid.description: Output only. A system-generated, globally unique ID for the metadata job. If the metadata job is deleted and then re-created with the same name, this ID is different.

updateTime.description: Output only. The time when the feed was updated.
